title: CALM: Class-wise Agreement and Label-gated Disagreement Modulation for Decentralized Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.05884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional federated learning relies on parameter averaging, which forces clients to be doubly homogeneous: all must run an identical architecture, and accuracy degrades when local data are non-IID. Decentralized federated distillation sidesteps both: each client runs its peers' model snapshots as teachers on its own local data and distills from their soft predictions, with no server, no public data, and no shared architecture. Under severe non-IID skew, however, the trustworthiness of the aggregated teacher target is a matter of degree, yet existing pipelines make hard, all-or-nothing decisions: outlier teachers are discarded by threshold, and whatever target survives is trusted in full. translated_title: CALM：面向去中心化联邦学习的类级一致性与标签门控分歧调制
translated_abstract: 传统联邦学习依赖于参数平均，这要求客户端具有双重同质性：所有客户端必须运行完全相同的模型架构，且当本地数据为非独立同分布（non-IID）时精度会显著下降。去中心化联邦蒸馏则同时规避了这两个问题：每个客户端将其他客户端的模型快照作为教师模型，在本地数据上运行并从其软预测中进行蒸馏，无需服务器、无需公共数据、也无需共享架构。然而，在严重的非独立同分布数据偏斜下，聚合教师目标的可信度是一个程度问题，而现有流程却做出硬性的全有或全无决策：离群教师被阈值直接丢弃，而幸存下来的目标则被完全信任。我们提出了CALM，它在三个层面上用平滑的信任门控取代所有硬性决策：在类别层面，教师根据与同伴共识的一致性进行加权；在样本层面，蒸馏强度根据教师与该目标的分歧程度进行调制；以及一个……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CALM方法，在去中心化联邦蒸馏中以平滑的多层信任门控（类级一致性加权和样本级分歧调制）取代现有硬性的全有或全无决策，从而提升严重非独立同分布数据下的模型聚合可信度和精度。
en_tdlr: CALM replaces hard all-or-nothing trust decisions in decentralized federated distillation with smooth multi-level trust gates—class-wise agreement weighting and sample-wise disagreement modulation—to improve robustness under severe non-IID data skew.
